name: io.github.teddYTIgers/certbeforepay
title: cbp-guard
description: Check an x402 payTo for scam/phishing and address-poisoning lookalikes before paying. $0.01/check.

environmentVariables.name: CBP_GUARD_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key (0x + 64 hex) of YOUR wallet that pays for each check via x402 (USDC on Base). Use a low-balance wallet.

environmentVariables.name: CBP_GUARD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: CertBeforePay base URL (default https://certbeforepay.com). Must be https.

environmentVariables.name: CBP_GUARD_DAILY_BUDGET_USD
environmentVariables.description: Spend cap per UTC day for this server process in USD (default 2.50; Infinity for no cap).
